description: Appointment hour box accepted any shape WPF could coerce: typing 10.00 or 20-00 silently saved 10:00
repro_steps: Agenda > new appointment > type 10.00 in the Hora box > Save > the appointment lands at 10:00

description: Appointment duration box bound the int directly, so WPF coerced whatever it could instead of refusing it
repro_steps: Agenda > new appointment > type a non-number in the Durada box > Save

description: Sale line VAT box bound raw basis points, so a typed 21 meant 0,21 % and was frozen onto the sale
repro_steps: Sales > new sale > add a line > type 21 in the VAT box > Charge > the ticket keeps 0,21 %

description: Sale line quantity box bound the int directly and was never validated before charging
repro_steps: Sales > new sale > add a line > type a non-number in the quantity box > Charge

description: Till movement crashed on Save when Desglossar IVA was ticked and the VAT box held anything but a number
repro_steps: Till > new cash in > tick Desglossar IVA > type letters in the VAT box > Save > FormatException from decimal.Parse

description: Opening-hours boxes guessed at 9, 0900 and 9.00, the same leniency that made 10.00 read as 10:00
repro_steps: Settings > opening hours > type 9.00 as a start hour > Save

description: Service duration accepted anything and silently stored no duration at all when it did not parse
repro_steps: Catalogue > new service > type letters in the duration box > Save > the service is saved with no duration

description: Client mobile and email were never format-checked
repro_steps: Clients > new client > type letters as the mobile > Save

description: Money.TryParse threw OverflowException instead of returning false for an out-of-range amount, crashing every price/amount box that guards with it
repro_steps: Sales > new sale > add a line > type 99999999999 as the price > Charge > unhandled OverflowException

description: SaleLineViewModel.AmountCents (price * Quantity) was unchecked int arithmetic with no upper bound on Quantity, so a large quantity silently overflowed and froze a wrong total onto the sale
repro_steps: Sales > new sale > add a line > price 1000,00 and quantity 3000000 > Charge > the ticket total is wrong/negative

description: Appointment.EndTime and AvailabilityService computed the end of an appointment with TimeOnly.AddMinutes, which wraps past midnight silently, breaking overlap and opening-hours checks for a late appointment with a long duration
repro_steps: Agenda > new appointment > 23:30 start, 90 min duration > Save > no overlap/out-of-hours warning even though it runs past closing

description: Editing a sale (or charging an appointment) stamped DateTime.Now over its date, moving a recorded sale out of its VAT quarter, its month in the reports and onto today's till
repro_steps: Sales > open a sale from a previous month > Edit > Charge > the sale is now dated today

description: Till VAT breakdown, till movements and the sale line total bound raw *Cents properties, so cents were printed as if they were euros: a 121,00 EUR period read 12100,00 and a 15,00 EUR sale line read 1500
repro_steps: Till > any period with sales > the per-rate table and the Amount column show figures 100x too large; Sales > new sale > add a line > the line total shows raw cents

description: The till's VAT block showed the till balance under a Total label: both were bound to BalanceText, so the VAT total included cash movements that carry no VAT
repro_steps: Till > add a cash movement > the Total in the IVA block changes even though no sale did

description: The per-rate VAT table was hidden whenever the period used a single VAT rate, so the rate the money was taxed at was not shown at all
repro_steps: Till > a period whose sales all use 21% > the per-rate table is not rendered

description: Till movements table showed the raw DateOnly and the stored enum name (In/Out) instead of localised text, and the Category and Worker columns were always blank because the query never included them
repro_steps: Till > add a cash out with a category and a worker > the row shows In/Out untranslated and no category or worker

description: Most spend and Highest average rankings listed client names without the amount they were ranked on
repro_steps: Reports > the two ranking cards show only names

description: Sale dialog line headers declared 7 grid columns while each row declared 11, so every header sat left of the box it named and drifted further across the row
repro_steps: Sales > new sale > add a line > the Quantitat/Preu/IVA headers do not line up with their boxes

description: Money.TryParse stripped group separators without validating them, so a stuck comma key turned 12,,50 into 12,50 and 1,2,3,4 into 123,40 - a number nobody typed, frozen onto the sale
repro_steps: Sales > new sale > add a line > type 1,2,3,4 as the price > Charge > the line is accepted as 123,40 EUR

description: ClientRecordViewModel formatted the average spend with a bare C2, taking the Windows regional setting instead of the app language, so one figure followed a different culture from the rest of the screen
repro_steps: Clients > open a client record with sales > the average is formatted differently from the total

description: ApplicationWpf test fixture waited on a ManualResetEventSlim with no timeout and swallowed any exception from App.InitializeComponent, so a broken App.xaml hung the whole test run instead of failing it
repro_steps: Break a StaticResource in App.xaml > run dotnet test > the run hangs with no output and no failing test

description: DatePicker.SelectedDate (DateTime?) was bound directly to a DateOnly/DateOnly? property with no converter in five pickers (Reports period range, Till custom range, Export range, client birth date), so the binding silently failed both ways: the picker showed empty and nothing typed ever reached the ViewModel
repro_steps: Informes > change the date range above Ranquing de treballadores > the worker ranking and detail never update

description: The 'Desglossar IVA als moviments de caixa' setting is written but never read, and the movement dialog hardcodes 21% instead of the configured default VAT rate
repro_steps: Settings > set the default VAT to 10% and tick 'Desglossar IVA als moviments de caixa' > Till > new cash out > the Desglossar box is still shown and unticked, and the VAT box reads 21

description: SettingsService.InvalidateCache blocks the UI thread on a SemaphoreSlim, so a restore can deadlock against any settings read in flight
repro_steps: Settings > restore a backup while another page is loading settings > the app hangs with no error

description: BackupService, AppointmentService, TillService and ExportService write or destroy data with no log line at all: restore, backup pruning, cash movement create/delete, appointment cancel/delete and the CSV export leave no audit trail
repro_steps: Settings > restore a backup > the log file has nothing between 'Application started' and 'Application closed'

description: Lowering 'Copies a conservar' permanently deletes backups with no confirmation and no log
repro_steps: Settings > change the number of backups to keep from 15 to 1 > Save > 14 backup files are deleted instantly with no warning

description: A File.Delete failure while pruning old backups makes a successful manual backup report as an error, so the user retries a backup that was already taken
repro_steps: Settings > hold an old .db in the backups folder open (antivirus, Explorer preview) > Fer copia ara > the new file is written but an unexpected-error dialog appears

description: Two user-visible strings are hardcoded Catalan literals in XAML StringFormat and are never translated
repro_steps: Settings > Idioma > Espanol > restart > the sales footer reads '12 vendes actives' and the slot-size picker reads '30 minuts' in a Spanish interface

description: ConfirmVatModeChange sets _modeVatSaved before awaiting the save, and is called fire-and-forget, so a failed write leaves the picker showing a VAT mode that was never stored and no error is surfaced
repro_steps: Settings > change the VAT mode with the settings write failing > the picker keeps the new mode and every later sale is still frozen in the old one

description: Eight (int) casts on long aggregates on the way to Money.Format reintroduce the clamps Money.cs documents as removed (HomeViewModel, ReportsViewModel, TillService)
repro_steps: Till/Home/Reports with a period total above 21.474.836,47 EUR > the figure wraps to a negative or wrong amount

description: The sales page footer sums int cents with Enumerable.Sum, which is checked and throws instead of widening
repro_steps: Sales > clear all filters with a lifetime total above 21.474.836,47 EUR > the page fails to load with an unhandled OverflowException

description: VatCalculator.ComputeByRate sums line amounts into an int, so two individually valid lines at the same VAT rate can overflow and crash while typing
repro_steps: Sales > new sale > add two lines at the same VAT rate, each priced 20000000,00 > the dialog throws an OverflowException on a keystroke

description: ExportService declares a fixed ca-ES culture so the CSV does not follow the interface language, but WriteSales formats through Money.FormatExport (interface culture, N2 with group separators) while WriteVat uses the fixed culture with F2 - the two files in one export disagree on number format
repro_steps: Sales > Exportar periode over a quarter containing a 1250,00 EUR sale > vendes_*.csv shows 1.250,00 and iva_*.csv shows 1250,00

description: AppointmentService.Create does not fire NotifyChanged while Update, ChangeStatus and Delete do, so a newly booked overdue appointment does not reach the shell notice until the next timer tick
repro_steps: Agenda > book an appointment for two hours ago > the overdue notice does not appear until the timer ticks

description: GetOverduePending only looks back 24 hours, so an appointment left Pending more than a day ago is invisible in the overdue notice forever
repro_steps: Agenda > leave a Friday appointment Pending > on Sunday the shell notice no longer mentions it

description: Guardar-lo igualment on a duplicate client reached ClientService.Create with a colliding ClientKey, so the unique index threw DbUpdateException uncaught - the global handler showed the unexpected-error dialog and the client was lost. Fixed by revising decision 6.1: ClientKey is now the whole normalised name, the phone takes no part, and the dialog refuses a repeated name instead of offering an override that could never work
repro_steps: Clients > new client > name Joan mobile 612345678 where a Joan/612345678 already exists > Save > the duplicate warning appears > Guardar-lo igualment > unexpected-error dialog and no client created

description: HomeViewModel.OpenMovementDialog never calls LoadDefaults, so a cash movement created from the Start page ignores both till VAT settings: the Desglossar IVA box is never offered even when apply_vat_to_till is on, and the rate box keeps the literal 21 instead of the configured default
repro_steps: Settings > set the default VAT to 10% and tick Desglossar IVA als moviments de caixa > Start > new cash out > no Desglossar box at all, while the same action from the Till page offers it

description: ReportsViewModel.Load and AgendaViewModel.LoadDayDetail clear an ObservableCollection and then await, so two overlapping loads duplicate every row. Reachable from the Aquest mes shortcut, from dragging a date picker, and from clicking two day headers in a row
repro_steps: Informes > with a range outside this month > Aquest mes > the ranking cards list each client twice

description: A cash movement is always stamped DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.Today), so one created while the Till page shows a past period is written outside the period and disappears from the table the user is looking at
repro_steps: Till > period Mes anterior > new cash out > the movement is saved but the table and the balance do not change

description: SalesViewModel.ClearFilters fires one fire-and-forget Load per filter it resets plus a final awaited Load, so up to nine queries race and the list and footer can end up showing a stale filter combination
repro_steps: Sales > set several filters > Netejar filtres > the table can keep showing a filtered subset while every filter box reads empty

description: ReportsView work-percentage column uses StringFormat {0:0.0}% which WPF resolves with the default en-US binding culture, so the column prints 12.5% with a dot while every other figure on the page follows AppLanguage.Culture
repro_steps: Informes > worker ranking with a fractional work percentage > the % column uses a decimal point and the money columns a comma

description: BackupServiceTests L-08 pins the configured backup hour at 23:59 and asserts the automatic backup has not run, which is false for the one minute a day the suite starts at 23:59
repro_steps: Run dotnet test between 23:59:00 and 23:59:59 > Before_the_configured_hour_the_automatic_backup_waits fails

description: Overdue appointments notice does not go away when the appointment is charged: SaleService.Create marks it Completed but never fires IAppointmentChangeNotifier, so the shell keeps naming it until the next timer tick; the notice also had no way to close it
repro_steps: Agenda > leave an appointment Pending more than an hour past its time > notice appears > charge it (Cobrar) > notice still names it

description: Closed ComboBoxes using DisplayMemberPath showed the item's ToString instead of its name: the app ComboBox template did not bind ContentTemplateSelector (where WPF puts DisplayMemberPath), so PaymentMethod/Product/ExpenseCategory boxes showed the type name; Client/Worker/Service only looked right because their ToString returns Name
repro_steps: Sales > new sale > choose a payment method > the closed box shows EvaGest.Models.PaymentMethod (same in cash-movement dialog and the sales filters)

description: Every WPF view test fails while the EvaGest app is running: App's constructor takes the EvaGest.SingleInstance mutex and calls Shutdown, so the test fixture's Application is dead and Application.Current is null
repro_steps: Start EvaGest > run dotnet test (with an alternative output path so the exe is not locked) > all Views tests fail with NullReferenceException / 'The Application object is being shut down'

description: Agenda arrows dropped the worker filter: the grid reloaded itself without it, so after moving to another week every worker's appointments showed while the filter still named one; the day detail also stayed open on a day no longer shown
repro_steps: Agenda > choose a worker in the filter > press Setmana següent > appointments of other workers appear

description: Editing an appointment or sale of an asleep client lost the client: the picker only held active clients, so the record reopened as a guest with an empty name
repro_steps: Clients > put a client to sleep who has a booked appointment > Agenda > open that appointment > the client box is Convidat and Save asks for a name

description: A sale with lines and a payment method but no client was refused with "choose a payment method": Charge only told apart no-lines from everything else
repro_steps: Sales > new sale > add a line > choose a payment method > leave the client empty > Cobrar > the error asks for the payment method

description: The Clients page toggle reads "Amagar clients adormits" in Catalan even with the app in Spanish: the checked text is a literal in ClientsView.xaml, not a Texts key
repro_steps: Configuració > language Español > restart > Clientes > click the show-asleep toggle > the label switches to Catalan

description: Deleting a client cascades to all their sales, Active ones included: past period totals and already-filed VAT change silently, and nothing is logged (ShopDbContext Sale->Client OnDelete Cascade, ClientService.Delete)
repro_steps: Clients > open a client with sales > Delete > confirm > Till/Export for an earlier period now shows lower totals

description: A voided sale could be deleted for good by asking to delete it a second time, erasing an accounting record (lines and VAT breakdown included) against RF-10, with only a rotating log line left
repro_steps: Sales > Delete an active sale (it is voided) > Delete it again > confirm > the sale is gone from the history

description: Editing a sale overwrote it in place (lines, totals, date, client) and the log only said "Sale N updated": nothing recorded what the ticket said before, so a sale could be moved into another, already filed, quarter without a trace
repro_steps: Sales > Edit a sale from last month > change its lines > Charge > no record of the old lines or total exists anywhere

description: The log file keeps only 30 days (retainedFileCountLimit: 30), yet it is the only audit trail for sale edits, voids, client deletions and cash movement deletions, which the books need for years
repro_steps: Use the app for 31 days > the first days log file is deleted, with every edit recorded in it

description: Deleting a cash movement removed it from the database outright (and TillService.Update overwrote one blindly), so a till figure could change with a rotating log line as the only trace
repro_steps: Till > delete a cash-out from last month > confirm > the movement no longer exists anywhere in the database

description: A custom concept line starts at 0 % VAT instead of the configured default, so the whole amount is booked as base with no quota unless the user edits the VAT box
repro_steps: Sales > New sale > + custom concept > type description and price > Charge > the sale's VAT is 0

description: Negative prices are accepted on sale lines and on catalogue services/products (Money.TryParse allows a sign and no caller checks >= 0), so a sale can be frozen with a negative total
repro_steps: Sales > New sale > custom concept > price -50 > Charge; or Catalogue > service price -10 > Save

description: A voided sale can still be edited: the Edit button is always visible and SaleService.Update never checks Status, so a voided ticket's lines and amounts can be rewritten
repro_steps: Sales > filter Voided > Edit a voided sale > change price > Charge

description: VAT split stored on cash movements (RF-13) is never aggregated: TillService.Summary and the iva_*.csv export only read SaleBreakdowns, so VAT on movements never reaches the accountant
repro_steps: Settings > apply VAT to till on > Till > cash-in 121 EUR with VAT split > Export period > iva CSV has no trace of the 21 EUR quota

description: SaleService.Create saves the sale and completes the appointment in two SaveChanges with no transaction; a failure between them leaves a charged appointment still Pending
repro_steps: Hard to reproduce by hand: fault on the second SaveChangesAsync after a sale from an appointment

description: Worker products %/other-concepts amounts are summed from SaleLine.AmountCents (net in VAT-exclusive mode) against Sale.TotalCents (gross), so the percentage is understated in NotIncluded mode
repro_steps: Settings > VAT mode not included > sell a 100 EUR product at 21 % > Reports > worker products % shows ~82.6 % instead of 100 %

description: Sales and cash movements kept no record of when they were entered: Date/Time is what the user types and can be edited, so a sale keyed in days later, or back-dated into a closed quarter, looked the same as one charged on the spot
repro_steps: Sales > New sale > it gets today; edit its date to last quarter > nothing in the database says it was entered today

description: An appointment whose Active sale exists can be switched to Cancelled or NoShow (ChangeStatus only guards Pending), leaving a counted sale linked to a cancelled appointment (F-05)
repro_steps: Agenda > charge an appointment > change its status to Cancelled

description: Backup pruning kept only the newest N copies (15 by default), so nothing older than about two weeks existed and damage noticed late was already in every backup
repro_steps: Settings > leave the default of 15 > after 16 days the first backup is gone; a problem from three weeks ago cannot be restored

description: CSV export does not neutralise fields starting with = + - @ (client, worker, concept), so a name like =HYPERLINK(...) is executed as a formula when the accountant opens vendes_*.csv in Excel
repro_steps: Create client named =1+1 > sell > Export > open vendes CSV in Excel > cell shows 2

description: VatCalculator.FitsInOneSale estimates the VAT-exclusive quota with truncating integer division while ComputeByRate rounds away from zero, and sum + quota is unchecked int: a group landing exactly on int.MaxValue can wrap to a negative total
repro_steps: Unit test: one NotIncluded line whose base + truncated quota == int.MaxValue but rounded quota is one cent higher

description: SaleService trusted the AmountCents handed in by the caller and never checked it against UnitPriceCents x Quantity, so a line could be frozen with an amount its own price and quantity do not explain
repro_steps: Only reachable through a caller other than the sale dialog; unit test: Quantity 2, UnitPriceCents 1500, AmountCents 1500 is saved

description: A VAT rate typed with more than two decimals was silently rounded (21,005 became 21,01 %) and frozen onto every sale using it, while Money refuses a third decimal of a euro
repro_steps: Catalogue > service VAT 21,005 > Save > the service is saved at 21,01 %

description: The sales CSV wrote dates and times with culture-sensitive separators ("/" and ":" in a .NET format string follow the current culture), so the files date shape depended on the machines regional settings
repro_steps: Windows region set to German > Export period > vendes CSV dates read 07.09.2026

description: Backups and restores copied barberia.db with File.Copy while the database runs in WAL mode behind pooled connections: a backup taken with the app open missed every commit still in barberia.db-wal (on a young database, the tables themselves), and a restore left the live -wal behind so the next read replayed it over the restored pages and the restore silently did nothing
repro_steps: Settings > Fer copia ara right after charging a sale > restore that copy later > the sale is not in it; or Settings > Restaurar any copy > the data on screen after reopening is unchanged

description: Reopening an appointment whose sale was voided and charging it again crashed on the unique index sales.appointment_id, because the voided sale still claimed the appointment; the global handler showed the unexpected-error dialog and the new sale was lost
repro_steps: Agenda/Start > charge an appointment > Sales > void that sale > Start > Tornar a pendent on the appointment > Completada > Cobrar > unexpected-error dialog, no sale

description: Money.TryParse read the last dot as the decimal point even with three digits after it, so 1.200 (how a Catalan or Spanish user writes one thousand two hundred) was stored as 1,20 EUR and 1.000.000 as 1.000,00 EUR
repro_steps: Till > new cash out > amount 1.200 for the rent > Save > the movement is 1,20 EUR

description: Start page appointments table printed the raw TimeOnly and the stored enum name, and the client record history the raw DateOnly: WPF formats them with the en-US binding culture, so a Catalan screen read 10:00 AM, Pending and 9/26/2026
repro_steps: Start > with an appointment today > the Hora column reads 10:00 AM and the Estat column Pending; Clients > open a client with history > dates are month-first

description: Deleting a client permanently deletes their active sales (cascade, by design in RF-04) but is not logged at all and is offered on the public Clients page with owner mode closed, so any worker can remove charged sales from the till, the reports and an already exported VAT quarter without a trace
repro_steps: Owner mode closed > Clients > open a client with sales > Eliminar > confirm > the till total for those days drops and the log has no line for it

description: Restore took its pre-restore safety copy, which pruned old backups straight away, before reading the chosen backup: with the folder at its retention limit, restoring the oldest copy deleted that very file first, so the restore failed with an unexpected-error dialog and the backup was gone
repro_steps: Settings > Copies a conservar 3 with 3 backups on disk > Restaurar > pick the oldest > confirm > unexpected-error dialog, and that backup no longer exists

description: ExportServiceTests.The_figures_are_written_the_same_way_in_either_language calls AppLanguage.Use(Spanish), which sets the process-wide default UI culture while every other test class runs in parallel, so unrelated tests intermittently read Spanish labels (seen: AgendaDetailDayTests expected No assistida, got No asistida). Moving it to a DisableParallelization collection made the run hang when that collection started, so it is not fixed that way
repro_steps: Run dotnet test several times in a row > roughly one run in five fails a label assertion in an unrelated class

description: Reopening an appointment whose sale was voided nulled the voided sale's appointment_id to free the unique index, so after charging again the voided sale read as a standalone sale and the history lost that the visit was charged, voided and charged again
repro_steps: Charge an appointment > void the sale > Tornar a pendent > charge again > the voided sale no longer belongs to the appointment
